Round 2.5 — fix pass

Skip Rocks for Brainrots · ui-foundation @ f3b25f2 · 2026-09-19 · fixes for the six round-2 findings, no redesign. Re-verified in Play on the owner's profile; desktop 1891×785, iPhone 16 simulator 733×371.

Fixes

Phone Egg Shop / merchant Fixed

Both shops moved to HudLayout's Panel layer (40+) so the Toggle layer (30) can't draw over them; SideRail publishes RailPanelOpen and every phone chrome yielder (HIDE UI, luck chip, Sprint + throw cluster + tab bar, quest bar, ride tab, rail + currency cluster) stands down for the shops too. Wallet chip 150 → 172.

Desktop shop clip Fixed

Shop scale clears the currency cluster's painted edge by 8 px (1.0232 → 1.0129 at 1891 px, ≈1 %), re-fit on every open.

Luck flyout close Fixed

Kit close in the title row; the ×N plate is no longer an invisible hit area.

Season Pass Fixed

Rows 104/12 → 82/8, column head 62 → 54, badge rides the row → 4 tiers visible; egg names fixed (double “x<qty>” removed), count moved to a pip, name width clears the widest chip.

Foil sparkle Fixed

Sparkles at (0.5, 0.36) / (0.12, 0.5) / (0.88, 0.5): inside the art well, clear of badge stacks and the rate pill on grid and pad plates.

Performance re-test Measured

Focused client at 59.7 fps: cold open 600 ms (595 ms frame), warm open 224 ms (283 ms frame), 400-item fill 2.35 s at ≈8 fps, scrolling 400 at 29 fps, live viewports ≤ 56 (culler self-capped to 48). Real hitches → proposals below, nothing changed.

Performance re-test (focused client)

CaseResult
Baseline (focused, idle world)59.7 fps
Cold first open, real bag (52 cards)600 ms request→visible · one 595 ms frame + 108 ms · 32 live viewports
Warm re-open (52 cards)224 ms request→visible · one 283 ms frame + 103 ms
400-item snapshot, Bag open2,353 ms fill · first frame 344 ms, then 15 × 108–141 ms (24 cards/chunk, ≈8 fps) · 59.8 fps after · 32 live

Attribution bench (24 cards)18 ms Lua + ~80 ms engine work in the landing frame (layout / text fitting / stroke+gradient geometry; same off-screen) + ~45 ms for 24 viewport mounts → ≈4 ms per card in situ

Visible hitching: yes — a 0.3 s (warm) / 0.6 s (cold) frame on every Bag open, and a 400-card fill that runs at 8 fps for two seconds. That counts as a real problem, so these are proposed and not implemented in this pass:

  1. Chunk 24 → ~6 cards per Heartbeat and mount viewports 8 per frame (not 32 at once): every build frame under ~35 ms; a 400 fill in ~1.1 s at 40–60 fps instead of 2.3 s at 8 fps.
  2. Reuse card instances across DataUpdated (diff by Uid) instead of rebuilding the grid — removes the 283 ms warm-open frame and the rebuild on every snapshot.
  3. Build the bay's 16 pad cards only when the fold-out is expanded (it opens collapsed).
  4. Trim per-card engine cost: ~25 GuiObjects with several TextScaled labels and per-element strokes; fixed text sizes computed once and fewer strokes would roughly halve the ~3.3 ms engine cost per card.
  5. Scrolling: pool ViewportFrames and swap models instead of clone-on-mount; mount ahead of the visible edge in small batches.
